BiblicalUsage: Jarha was an Egyptian servant in the house of Sheshan, who had no sons but daughters. Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha to wife, and she bare him Attai, so that an Egyptian became the father of a line in Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God grafts the outsider into His people, and Jarha's son stands in the genealogy of Judah.
